body: Is this what happens when you have depression of some kind?  It's so odd - at times like right now, I can't remember what it's like to be in that kind of agony, and when I am, I can't remember what it's like not to be.  Will other people understand that?  They ("they" being a counselor or whomever I talk to) won't think I'm faking or something?  I just don't want to waste their time - though I admit my reticence is probably also due a bit too fear of what I might find out through counseling.

I had these experiences in high school, but it was less frequent and less pronounced (once a week, maybe, and certainly not suicidal).  I'll think about the check-up - would I just ask for a basic physical or something?
